scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd apps/backend && go run ./cmd/buddy-ssh" "bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/shared build && bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/frontend build && cd apps/backend && go build -o ../../bin/buddy-ssh ./cmd/buddy-ssh
scripts.test: bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/shared test && bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/frontend test && cd apps/backend && go test ./...
scripts.test:frontend: bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/shared test && bun run --filter @buddy-ssh/frontend test
scripts.lint: biome check . && cd apps/backend && golangci-lint run
